SEO_TITLE: Agent Status — status pages for AI agents
SEO_DESCRIPTION: Public status page for any AI agent: uptime, last-run timestamp, error rate, incident log. Free for 1 agent, $19/mo per agent after.
SEO_KEYWORDS: ai agent status page, ai agent uptime, mcp server status, agent monitoring, ai agent observability
HERO_SUBHEAD: Users are asking whether your agent is down. Give them a page instead of a Discord DM. Uptime, last run, error rate, incident log — public URL per agent.
HERO_MICRO_PROOF: Free for 1 agent. Ping /heartbeat every 60s from your agent, we do the rest.
PROBLEM_STATEMENT: Your AI agent runs on a Cloudflare Worker, a Modal function, or a laptop under a desk. When it hiccups, the only signal your users get is silence. Statuspage.io is $79/mo and built for AWS regions. This is built for one agent that runs on cron.
FEATURE_1_BODY: status.agentreleasegate.com/<your-agent> — shareable, indexable, no login required. Green / yellow / red at a glance.
FEATURE_2_BODY: POST /api/heartbeat every 60s (or however often your agent runs). We compute uptime, last-run, error-rate, and p95 latency automatically.
FEATURE_3_BODY: Post incidents from the dashboard or via API. Subscribers get RSS + optional email. Never DM 'is it down?' again.
PRICING_FREE_BULLETS:
• 1 agent monitored
  • 7-day uptime history
  • Public status URL
  • Manual incident posting
PRICING_PRO_BULLETS:
• Unlimited agents
  • Forever history + p95 latency
  • RSS + email subscribers
  • Auto-incident on 3 consecutive misses
  • Slack / Discord webhook alerts
FAQ_1_A: Your agent sends POST /api/heartbeat?token=<yours> at the end of every run (successful or failed). Body is optional JSON with 'ok' (bool), 'latency_ms' (int), 'note' (string). We store the last 10k events per agent on the free tier.
FAQ_2_Q: What if my agent is a Cloudflare Worker with no outbound HTTP?
FAQ_2_A: Cloudflare Workers do have outbound fetch — just call from inside the handler. If you're truly locked down, use the browser-side pixel: add /agent/<token>/pixel.gif to any HTML your agent renders.
FAQ_3_Q: Is this a competitor to Statuspage / BetterStack / Instatus?
FAQ_3_A: No. Those are for multi-region SaaS with 50+ components. This is for one AI agent that runs on cron. Different market, different price, different UX.
FAQ_4_Q: Do you send alerts to Slack?
FAQ_4_A: Yes on Pro — paste a webhook URL, we ping on state transitions (green→red, red→green) and new incidents. No noise on transient blips.
